name: Pearl
title: Gloom Stalker Ranger
role: The party's archer: first to act, Titanstring Bow powered by Strength from gear, a shield on her back for AC.

gear.note: Adds your Strength modifier to damage. The heart of this build. Confirmed in game: it adds the Club's Strength.
STR 19 from the melee slot while you shoot. Check your STR on the character sheet with the bow drawn.
Free Hunter's Mark once a day, and Advantage against monstrosities.
1d10 + 1 and +1 to hit: the hardest-hitting bow until Titanstring.
+1 initiative.
+2 damage on ranged weapon attacks.
+1 to attack rolls (and DEX 18 if yours is lower).
+2 acid on every weapon hit, possibly each Arrow of Many Targets hit (check in game).
+1d4 psychic on weapon hits while you concentrate (Hunter's Mark).
+1d6 poison on your weapon after you're healed. Your Act 1 amulet, and the swap in Acts 2–3 once the Surgeon's amulet has fired (there's a second copy in Act 3).
Momentum (extra movement) for 3 turns at the start of combat.
Bonus-action Misty Step each short rest; immune to webs, grease and ice.
+1 to ranged attack rolls.
Advantage on attacks, Disadvantage on saves: the strongest Sharpshooter fix.
Can't be Blinded. Note: magical Darkness blocks ranged attacks into and out of it, so it doesn't let you shoot from inside Darkness.
+1d4 to ranged attacks while in shadow.
Haste once a day, plus cold resistance (you already resist fire).

Off hand with the Club (both are Light): each kill gives +1 to attack and damage rolls, up to +3, which offsets Sharpshooter's −5. Costs the shield's +2 AC and +3 initiative. Check in game that bow kills build the stacks and that arrows get the bonus. Drops from Cazador.
+3 initiative and Advantage on Perception.
+1d4 fire on weapon hits.
Bonus action for Advantage on weapon attacks, once per short rest. While it's active, healing spells can't target you (potions still work).
+1 AC.
Crit range −1 and double proficiency on attack rolls. Gives up Titanstring's Strength damage.
A chance of Guiding Bolt on hit (Advantage for everyone) and Haste once a day. Gives up Titanstring's Strength damage.
STR 23: +6 per arrow instead of the Club's +4, but in the gloves slot.
+2 to weapon attack and damage rolls.
+2 to attack rolls, initiative and Perception.
Darkvision and can't be Blinded; Advantage on CON saves.
+2 initiative and See Invisibility. Bhaal path only: Vesper can buy it from the Echo of Abazigal.
Crit range −1 while hiding.
16 + full DEX.
14 + full DEX, +2 initiative, Shield once per short rest, and Advantage on Stealth. In vault nº9 at the Counting House; the key comes from Return Rakath's Gold.
+2 initiative and Advantage on DEX saves.
+2 AC, and 8 temporary HP once per short rest when you take damage below half HP.
+2 AC and +1 to saving throws.
+1d4 to attack rolls against your Hunter's Mark target.
Once per long rest, a crit on a humanoid Paralyses it for 2 turns. Once it has fired, swap back to Broodmother's Revenge.
Light armour: 12 + full DEX (16 at DEX 18) and +1 Stealth. Her Act 1 armour, from the Underdark.
15 + 2 DEX = 17 AC. Vesper takes the Hollow's copy, so this is only if a trader stocks another (from level 6).
14 + full DEX and no Stealth Disadvantage: her Act 2 armour.
